name: Queen Wagtoggle
guide_text: Mainly a tempo hero that gives you free stats throughout the midgame. Don't play too hard into it.
buddy_guide_text: Buy the first copy of your buddy when it costs at most 3 gold, because it doesn't generate value. The golden version of your buddy is powerful, and benefits from concentrated stats ([[Avalanche Caller]], [[Insatiable Ur'zul||72060]])
